name: @ocs/encodings
//: Legacy character encodings, for turning typed text into bytes in GBK, Big5, Shift_JIS, EUC-JP/KR, gb18030, ISO-2022-JP, the ISO-8859 set and the Windows code pages. TextEncoder in every browser emits UTF-8 and nothing else — by design, per the WHATWG standard — so encoding to these needs shipped tables. The encoding catalogue itself lives in @ocs/contracts, since a share link carries these ids; the 635 KB of vendored engine and tables sits behind a dynamic import in `./src/legacy.ts` and loads the first time one of these encodings is actually selected.
